name: Phong Shading
aliases: Phong Shading — Phong Illumination, Phong Illumination Model, Phong Model, Phong Reflection Model, Phong Shading Model
definition: A local illumination model combining ambient, diffuse, and specular components to color the rendered surface.
summary: Phong Shading is a local illumination model that approximates direct lighting by summing ambient, diffuse, and specular components, distinguished by computing specular highlights based on the angle between the view direction and the reflection vector.
